primary_public_sources.source_observation: DSSE defines KEYID as optional and an unauthenticated hint indicating what key and algorithm were used.

The signature keyid is an optional unauthenticated hint; key distribution, PKI, certificate validation and trust roots are external, and keyid is not a key-management mechanism and must not be used for security decisions.

The DSSE envelope keyid cannot supply that trust because it is unauthenticated and is not part of the security decision surface.
